audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race: canonical check at L138 (batch.canonical()) occurs before data retrieval at L143 (dataColumnStorage.Get(blockRoot)). Fork choice can reorg between these operations, causing orphaned block sidecars to be served despite passing the earlier canonical filter.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker requests data column range via P2P, then triggers fork choice reorg by withholding then gossiping a competing block with higher weight during the gap between canonical filtering and data retrieval, causing the server to serve sidecars for blocks no longer on the canonical chain.
